title: Convert UTC instants to wall-clock time in named zones
summary: Convert 200 UTC instants to the local date-time and UTC offset in one IANA time zone, across daylight-saving transitions and half- and quarter-hour offsets.
notes: One operation is 200 conversions in one zone, each with its formatting into a local date-time string and the offset in seconds; the zone is looked up by name once per fixture, outside timing. Each entry uses its own copy of the tz database (the system's files, ICU's, or one it bundles); the instants lie in 2012-2024, where these zones' rules agree in every recent release.
